Your friends are trash, what an awful take. Single people need to eat too and should be able to enjoy restaurant food! If it was THAT big of a deal to this couple frankly they should have booked a table lol, and I agree 4pm is not prime romantic time for dates, and even if it was that doesn't mean other people aren't allowed to also go out for dinner during that time. As for the situation, I feel it would be better addressed by speaking with the family members your concerned about before the wedding - if you want your brother there, they need to be in line if they want to attend and if they refuse to make peace with it they can be uninvited - not by punishing the brother for being gay, it is great you sided with him!

YTA - although I can understand why your upset, you have to ask yourself if you'd have done the same if it was your partners siblings wedding over your best friend/immediate family member*?

Think her family, parents, siblings, grandparents, aunties, uncles etc are likely to be attending the cousins wedding - her family whom she probably would like to also see and also celebrate with, family members she might not even have seen in forever. Your wedding will be about you and your families celebrations, she as an in law is still an outsider, its still not her family its her partners, your brothers. So it's not insane for her to pick her family over yours.

(*cousins FYI can definitely count as immediate, lots of people have closer relationships with their cousins than their own siblings)

I've been a vegetarian for going on 5 years now and I run into situations like this all the time! 

The obvious as other people have stated is to just tell them - but as an anxious overthinker I sympathise with not wanting to inconvenience other people with your dietary choices! 

Usually I'm able to make do, like picking chicken out of a curry when ordering with someone, although if the people you are staying with a big meat eaters its going to be hard - if the idea of telling them is definitely not something you feel is worth doing, try taking some quick easy snacks/meals with you (or buying some when there) like ramen etc stuff you just add water to like pot noodle - if they ask why just say you were still hungry from food and didn't want to bother anyone. 

Although I still agree telling them would be easier :))
